---
title: Code block style, filename bar
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      noErrors: default
---

A template sets the filename bar keys and a per-side stroke in `quarto-code-block-style`.
The bar must use `surface`, `title-inset` and `label`, and only the frame draws the stroke.

```{=typst}
#quarto-code-block-style.update(s => s + (
  surface: rgb("#203040"),
  label: rgb("#f0f0f0"),
  title-inset: (x: 12pt, y: 6pt),
  stroke: (top: 2pt + red, rest: none),
))
#show "example.py": it => context {
  if text.fill == rgb("#f0f0f0") { counter("cbs-label").step() }
  it
}
#show block: it => {
  if it.fill == rgb("#203040") {
    assert(it.inset.left == 12pt and it.inset.top == 6pt, message: "the bar must use title-inset")
    counter("cbs-surface").step()
  }
  let s = it.stroke
  if type(s) == dictionary and s.at("top", default: none) != none and s.top.paint == red {
    counter("cbs-frame").step()
  }
  it
}
```

```{.python filename="example.py"}
x = 1
```

```{=typst}
#context {
  assert.eq(counter("cbs-surface").final().first(), 1, message: "expected 1 filename bar with the surface fill")
  assert.eq(counter("cbs-label").final().first(), 1, message: "expected the filename in the label colour")
  assert.eq(counter("cbs-frame").final().first(), 1, message: "expected only the frame to draw the stroke")
}
```
